purpose: Freeze every English prompt, source, tuning example, rubric, calibration control, and development fixture before independently authoring the final English holdout.
validation_scope: Local English data and parser contracts only; no inference, Azure execution, or release-quality claim.

development_provenance.v2_dev: Deterministically derived from all 20 translated legacy-v1 cases, preserving original IDs and splits in origin.
development_provenance.v3_dev_initial: Deterministically derived from English v2 dev plus the already exposed English v2 holdout. This is a localized provenance snapshot, not historical run evidence.
development_provenance.v3_dev: Byte-for-byte consistent with scripts/prepare_eval_v3.py when DATA selects data/en, including its existing, documented citation-equivalence review for the exposed v2 access regression. No new equivalence groups or oracle relaxations were introduced.
development_provenance.v3_calibration: Byte-identical to English v2 calibration; eight fixed correct/incorrect controls.
development_provenance.preparation_note: The v3 transformation needs no English-specific authoring logic once DATA selects data/en. The v2 preparation script's two additional calibration controls contain hard-coded Korean text; regenerating those controls requires an English-aware authoring path rather than copying its Korean literals.
development_provenance.historical_evidence: The original Korean data, original v3 holdout, original manifests, and all prior validation evidence were left unchanged.
